title: Panthers release OL Saahdiq Charles, WR Ainias Smith from IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Panthers release OL Saahdiq Charles, WR Ainias Smith from IR
sources.description: The Panthers waived wide receiver Ainias Smith with an injury settlement and released guard Saahdiq Charles with an injury settlement, the team announced Thursday.
